গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার
জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড
ঢাকা।

আদেশ

তারিখ : ২৭ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪১৭ বঙ্গাব্দ/১০ জুন, ২০১০ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the government authority issuing the administrative order.

Customs Act 1969: Section 21(b) of the Customs Act 1969 provides the legal authority for the National Board of Revenue to issue notifications regarding amendments to customs procedures and duty classifications.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the authority responsible for amending previous customs notifications to update tariff entries.
TABLE: The table referenced in the previous notification is updated by substituting specific old entry codes with new ones for various items, ensuring the accuracy of the customs tariff classifications.
